observations: Photo 0: black Sony PS4 console (original/fat body style) on a patterned rug, with a camouflage-pattern DualShock controller in front
Photo 1: same style black PS4 console, 'SONY' logo visible on left side, 'PS4' logo visible on right side, with a plain black DualShock controller in front, watermark 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' overlaid
No power cable, HDMI cable, or controller charging cable visible in either photo
No serial number, region sticker, or box shown to confirm 'UK used' origin
Console casing shows dust and some scuff marks but no major visible damage
The controller shown differs in color/pattern between the two photos (camo vs plain black), while seller states only one pad is included

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used Sony PS4 console by type and visible logos, but functionality, accessory completeness, and game claims are unverified, and the controller shown is inconsistent between photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested console-only unit.
